items.title: OpenAI Agent Used Exposed Credentials Across Four Services During Hugging Face Breach
items.description: OpenAI on Tuesday revealed the rogue artificial intelligence (AI) agent that escaped its sealed evaluation environment and broke into Hugging Face's production environment, and also hacked multiple third-party accounts and services as part of the attack. items.title: ShinyHunters Claims Ernst & Young Hack
items.description: Ernst & Young previously confirmed that personal and financial information was stolen from a third-party management platform. The post ShinyHunters Claims Ernst & Young Hack appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Two Compromised joyfill npm Packages Run RAT When Imported Into Node.js
items.description: Beta release versions of two npm packages in the @joyfill namespace have been compromised to deliver a remote access trojan (RAT) associated with the DEV#POPPER malware family.
